_comment: Quest tier defaults pushed to the headset as hm_data/quest_settings.json by Tools/deploy_data.ps1 -Push (kept if the headset has its own; -ReplaceSettings replaces it). Keys: Assets/VR/Runtime/VrSettings.cs, docs/SPLAT_DANCERS.md 'Quest'. Never lay this out in Builds/data: a Windows player reads quest_settings.json from its data folder too.
